{ "item": { "id": "4750ab20-45c1-4710-84cf-4abe41bdff8c", "content_type": "generic", "workflow_state": "public", "page_title": "Concepts", "short_description": "The three core building blocks of Godzilla: pipelines, connectors, and events.", "body": "{{ds:component/hero|title=Concepts|subtitle=The three building blocks every Godzilla pipeline is made of.|cta_html=Start with Pipelines}}

Godzilla is built from three ideas that compose into everything else in these docs. Understanding how they relate makes the rest of the platform — guides, API reference, SDKs — much easier to follow.

{{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/1c05e59d-f366-4176-a6ca-8f52ccfb3ce6}}|tag=Concept|title=Pipelines|description=Named, versioned workflows that move data from a source to a destination through optional transforms.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/9abaed7a-d8e0-4359-8beb-09b323107b37}}|tag=Concept|title=Connectors|description=Pre-built integrations to external systems — sources, destinations, or both.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/51573947-e8c4-48fb-9b1d-148c2a99aa85}}|tag=Concept|title=Events|description=The atomic unit of data flowing through a pipeline, plus the platform's own lifecycle events.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/132b7ae5-caad-4f00-a0dd-779f9a64c41c}}|tag=Concept|title=Schemas|description=How to declare and validate event payload shapes using JSON Schema.}}

How they fit together

A pipeline reads events from a source connector, transforms them, and writes them to a destination connector. Everything else in Godzilla — retries, webhooks, monitoring — is built on top of that single loop. Schemas let you declare and enforce the shape of those events for data quality and safety.

Definitions

Short definitions for every term used throughout these docs.

Pipeline
A named, versioned workflow that moves data from a source connector, through optional transforms, to a destination connector.
Connector
A pre-built integration to an external system — a source, a destination, or both.
Event
The atomic unit of data moving through a pipeline, or a platform lifecycle notification like pipeline.failed.
Webhook
An outbound HTTP request Godzilla sends to a URL you control when a subscribed event occurs.
Dead-letter queue
Where an event goes after exhausting its retries, rather than being dropped. See Handling errors & retries.
Cursor pagination
The pagination style used by every v2 list endpoint. See Rate limits & errors.
Workspace
The top-level account boundary an API key is scoped to.

input.body:
{{ds:component/hero|title=Concepts|subtitle=The three building blocks every Godzilla pipeline is made of.|cta_html=Start with Pipelines}}

Godzilla is built from three ideas that compose into everything else in these docs. Understanding how they relate makes the rest of the platform — guides, API reference, SDKs — much easier to follow.

{{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/8fc48def-6cf0-4c5c-bb1e-07c733563b38}}|tag=Concept|title=Pipelines|description=Named, versioned workflows that move data from a source to a destination through optional transforms.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/d0c8088b-4e58-4709-a7d5-dd47f21b3d64}}|tag=Concept|title=Connectors|description=Pre-built integrations to external systems — sources, destinations, or both.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/1ea1b320-4083-4c93-b73b-bb0e429abcae}}|tag=Concept|title=Events|description=The atomic unit of data flowing through a pipeline, plus the platform's own lifecycle events.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/132b7ae5-caad-4f00-a0dd-779f9a64c41c}}|tag=Concept|title=Schemas|description=How to declare and validate event payload shapes using JSON Schema.}}

How they fit together

A pipeline reads events from a source connector, transforms them, and writes them to a destination connector. Everything else in Godzilla — retries, webhooks, monitoring — is built on top of that single loop. Schemas let you declare and enforce the shape of those events for data quality and safety.

Definitions

Short definitions for every term used throughout these docs.

Pipeline
A named, versioned workflow that moves data from a source connector, through optional transforms, to a destination connector.
Connector
A pre-built integration to an external system — a source, a destination, or both.
Event
The atomic unit of data moving through a pipeline, or a platform lifecycle notification like pipeline.failed.
Webhook
An outbound HTTP request Godzilla sends to a URL you control when a subscribed event occurs.
Dead-letter queue
Where an event goes after exhausting its retries, rather than being dropped. See Handling errors & retries.
Cursor pagination

{{ds:component/hero|title=Concepts|subtitle=The three building blocks every Godzilla pipeline is made of.|cta_html=Start with Pipelines}}

Godzilla is built from three ideas that compose into everything else in these docs. Understanding how they relate makes the rest of the platform — guides, API reference, SDKs — much easier to follow.

{{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/8fc48def-6cf0-4c5c-bb1e-07c733563b38}}|tag=Concept|title=Pipelines|description=Named, versioned workflows that move data from a source to a destination through optional transforms.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/d0c8088b-4e58-4709-a7d5-dd47f21b3d64}}|tag=Concept|title=Connectors|description=Pre-built integrations to external systems — sources, destinations, or both.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/1ea1b320-4083-4c93-b73b-bb0e429abcae}}|tag=Concept|title=Events|description=The atomic unit of data flowing through a pipeline, plus the platform's own lifecycle events.}} {{ds:component/card|href={{cms:item/132b7ae5-caad-4f00-a0dd-779f9a64c41c}}|tag=Concept|title=Schemas|description=How to declare and validate event payload shapes using JSON Schema.}}

How they fit together

A pipeline reads events from a source connector, transforms them, and writes them to a destination connector. Everything else in Godzilla — retries, webhooks, monitoring — is built on top of that single loop. Schemas let you declare and enforce the shape of those events for data quality and safety.

Definitions

Short definitions for every term used throughout these docs.

Pipeline
A named, versioned workflow that moves data from a source connector, through optional transforms, to a destination connector.
Connector
A pre-built integration to an external system — a source, a destination, or both.
Event
The atomic unit of data moving through a pipeline, or a platform lifecycle notification like pipeline.failed.
Webhook
An outbound HTTP request Godzilla sends to a URL you control when a subscribed event occurs.
Dead-letter queue
Where an event goes after exhausting its retries, rather than being dropped. See Handling errors & retries.
Cursor pagination
The pagination style used by every v2 list endpoint. See Rate limits & errors.
Workspace
The top-level account boundary an API key is scoped to.
